# SYNAPTIC Receptors expressed in CSF-cNs

## **1- GABA-A RECEPTORS**

```{r}

library(readxl)

GABA<- read_xlsx("GABA.xlsx")
#View(GABA)
names(GABA)
```

```{r}

GABA$Region ->Region

GABA$IGaba->IGaba
GABA$dGaba->dGaba
```

### a1) SUMMARIZE data for GABA-A Rs

#### Current

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(IGaba~Region,
          GABA,
          digits=0)

```

#### Current Density

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(dGaba~Region,
          GABA,
          digits=0)

```

### b1) PLOT Current DATA for GABA

#### Current

```{r}

Bx_Igaba <- ggplot(GABA, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=IGaba, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_Igaba + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-10000, 5000))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Bx_Igaba.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Pt_Igaba<-ggplot(GABA, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=IGaba, color=Region)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_Igaba + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-10000, 5000))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Pt_Igaba.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

#### Current Density

```{r}

Bx_dgaba <- ggplot(GABA, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=dGaba, color=Region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_dgaba + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-1500, 500))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Bx_dgaba.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Pt_dgaba<-ggplot(GABA, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=dGaba, color=Region)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=1, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_dgaba + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-1500, 500))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Pt_dgaba.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

### c1) STATISTICAL analysis for GABA CURRENTS

### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - GABA Current/Current Density

```{r}

kruskal.test(IGaba~Region, data = GABA)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(IGaba, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(IGaba ~ Region,
                    data   = GABA,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

```

### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - GABA Current Density

```{r}


kruskal.test(dGaba~Region, data = GABA)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(dGaba, Region,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(dGaba ~ Region,
                    data   = GABA,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

```

### a2) INHIBITION by Gabazine (Current density)

```{r}

library(readxl)
InhGABA<- read_excel("InhGABA.xlsx")
#View(InhGABA)
names(InhGABA)
```

```{r}

InhGABA$Region ->Region
InhGABA$Cond ->Cond
InhGABA$Amp ->Amp

```

### SUMMARIZE data for GABA-A Current density in Control and in Gabazine

```{r}
library(FSA)

Summarize(Amp~Cond,
          InhGABA,
          digits=0)

Summarize(Amp~Region*Cond,
          InhGABA,
          digits=0)
```

### b2) PLOT Current DATA for GABA-current in Control and GABAzine

```{r}

Region <- as.factor(Region)
Cond <- as.factor(Cond)


p0 <- ggplot(InhGABA, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=Amp, color=Cond)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
p0 + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-1500, 250))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Bx_GABA.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

p1<-ggplot(InhGABA, aes(x=Region<- factor(Region,levels = c("Lomb","Tho","Cerv")), y=Amp, color=Cond)) +
   geom_jitter(shape=16, position=position_jitter(0.1))  + theme_minimal()
p1 + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-1500, 500))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Pt_GABA.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
```

### c2) STATISTICAL analysis for GABA CURRENTS in Control and Gabazine

#### =\> Linear Model -\> region \* Condition

#### \## Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}

modelGABA = lm(Amp ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhGABA)

# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelGABA)



# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelGABA,type = "II")

```

#### \### Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

modelGABA = lm(Amp ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhGABA)
# Summary overall p-value and r-square 

summary(modelGABA)


library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelGABA,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelGABA, ~  Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat

```

### c2) STATISTICAL analysis for ACh CURRENTS - CTR vs. D-Tubo

#### =\> Linear model 2 Factors - Current Densities

#### #Define Linear Model -\> Region \* Cond

```{r}

# Analyse Données poolées
modelDT = lm(Dens ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhAch)

# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelDT)

```

#### \# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelDT,type = "II")

```

#### \## Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelDT,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelDT, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat
```

### c2) STATISTICAL analysis for Glu CURRENTS CTR vs DNQX

#### =\> Linear model 2 Factors

#### #Define Linear Model -\> Region \* Cond

```{r}

# Analyse Données poolées
modelG = lm(Amp ~ Region*Cond,
           data = InhGlu)

# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelG)

```

#### \# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelG,type = "II")

```

#### \## Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelG,
                      ~ Cond*Region,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelG, ~ Cond*Region)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Region")     # compare doses for each treat
```

```{r}
names(PGLU)
PGLU$Cond ->Condp
PGLU$Dens ->Densp

kruskal.test(Densp~Condp, data = PGLU)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Densp, Condp,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Densp ~ Condp,
                    data   = PGLU,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

```

## 5- ATP-g-S -mediated currents

```{r}
library(readxl)
ATP<- read_excel("ATP.xlsx")
#View(ATP)
names(ATP)
```

```{r}

ATP$Level ->Level
ATP$Cond->Cond
ATP$Dens->Dens
ATP$Cell-> Cell

# Ensure the order of Cond and Level in the summarized data
# Convert columns to factors to ensure proper ordering and grouping
ATP$Cond <- factor(ATP$Cond, levels = c("CTR","ATP"))
ATP$Level <- factor(ATP$Level, levels = c("Cerv", "Tho", "Lumb"))

```

### a) SUMMARIZE data for ATP-g-S-mediated currents

#### Current Density

```{r}
library(FSA)

#Current Density per Condiition
Summarize(Dens~Cond,
          ATP,
          digits=0)

#Current Density per Condition and Level
Summarize(Dens~Cond*Level,
          ATP,
          digits=0)

```

### b) PLOT Current DATA for ATP

#### Current Density

```{r}


Bx_ATP <- ggplot(ATP, aes(x=Cond, y=Dens, color=Level)) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.5) + theme_minimal()
Bx_ATP + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-75, 10))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Bx_ATP.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

Pt_ATP <-ggplot(ATP, aes(x=Cond, y=Dens, color=Level))+
  geom_jitter(shape=1, position=position_jitter(0.1))+ theme_minimal()
Pt_ATP + coord_cartesian( ylim = c(-75, 10))

ggsave(path = "Fig_Synaptic", filename = "Pt_ATP.eps", units="cm", width=10, height=6, dpi=300)

```

### c) STATISTICAL analysis for KAINATE-mediated CURRENTS

### =\> KRUSKAL WALLIS test - ATP-mediated Current

```{r}

kruskal.test(Dens~Cond, data = ATP)

library(rcompanion)

pairwise.wilcox.test(Dens, Level,
                 p.adjust.method = "BH")

Sum = groupwiseMean(Dens ~ Level,
                    data   = ATP,
                    conf   = 0.95,
                    digits = 3,
                    traditional = FALSE,
                    percentile  = TRUE)

```

#### =\> Linear model 2 Factors

#### #Define Linear Model -\> Region \* Cond

```{r}

# Analyse Données poolées
modelAt = lm(Dens ~ Level*Cond,
           data = ATP)

# Summary overall p-value and r-square 
summary(modelAt)

```

#### \# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

```{r}
# Conduct analysis of variance, Type II sum of squares

library(car)
Anova(modelAt,type = "II")

```

#### \## Post-hoc analysis: mean separation tests

```{r}

library(multcompView)
library(emmeans)
leastsquare = emmeans(modelAt,
                      ~ Cond*Level,
                      adjust = "sidak")
leastsquare

EMM <- emmeans(modelAt, ~ Cond*Level)
EMM    # display the cell means

### Simple pairwise comparisons...
pairs(EMM, simple = "Cond")    # compare treats for each dose -- "simple effects"
pairs(EMM, simple = "Level")     # compare doses for each treat
```
